goal: Is ke baad aap break se loop ko jaldi rok sakenge aur continue se ek turn skip kar sakenge, aur predict kar sakenge ke loop counter aur output ka kya hoga.
warmup: Aap 100 notebooks ke dher mein apne dost ki ek notebook dhoondh rahe hain. Jab woh mil jati hai to aap ruk jate hain: baaki 99 check nahi karte. Yeh break hai. Ab socho aap exam papers mark kar rahe hain aur ek paper par naam nahi likha. Aap usey ek taraf rakh dete hain aur agla paper utha lete hain. Aap ne marking band nahi ki. Yeh continue hai.
definition: break loop ko foran khatam kar deta hai. Program loop ke baad wali pehli line se aage chalta hai. continue sirf MAUJOODA turn (iteration) ko khatam karta hai. Program agle turn par chala jata hai. For loop mein update wala hissa (i++) agle test se pehle phir bhi run hota hai. While loop mein update nahi hota, is liye continue se pehle aap ko variable khud badalna hoga. break switch mein ek case ko bhi khatam karta hai. Yeh dono statements loop ke 'exceptions' hain: yeh us ki aam rhythm ko tod dete hain.
howItWorks: Pehli example ka flowchart ghor se dekhein. Loop test ek diamond hai. Body ke andar ek doosra diamond hai: i % 7 == 0. Agar woh true ho, to arrow loop mein wapis nahi jata. Woh loop ke baad wali line par jump kar ke bahar nikal jata hai. Yeh break hai. Doosri example mein if ka arrow loop ke update par wapis jata hai. Yeh continue hai. continue ke neeche wali body sirf us turn ke liye skip hoti hai. Doosre program ka trace dekhein: i = 3, 6 aur 9 ke liye step line 8 (continue) dikhata hai aur sum nahi badalta. Teen cheezein aur yaad rakhein. Pehli, break aur continue ke aas paas if hona zaroori hai. If ke baghair, un ke baad wali lines kabhi run nahi ho sakti. Doosri, nested loops mein break sirf us loop se nikalta hai jis mein woh likha hai, is liye bahar wala loop chalta rehta hai (teesri example dekhein). Teesri, loop ke andar switch mein break switch ko khatam karta hai, loop ko nahi. Switch ke andar se loop chhodne ke liye flag ya return use karein. Aam istemal: prime number check karna. Jab koi divisor mil jaye, to break karein, kyunke aur numbers test karne ki zaroorat nahi.
